threehourtour.trivia.ancient_remnant: Koboletons keep working the dig long after the dig stopped meaning anything.
threehourtour.trivia.ender_guardian: A golem built to hold a door shut. Nobody has ever found the door.
threehourtour.trivia.harbinger: The Prowler arrives first and alone. That is the warning; there is no second one.
threehourtour.trivia.ignis: Ignited things remember being iron. The revenant is what is left when the forge wins the argument.
threehourtour.trivia.mage_covenant: Seven robes, one grammar. The Covenant does not teach outsiders — it leaves its notes on the bodies.
threehourtour.trivia.maledictus: The draugr do not guard the barrow. They are the barrow, and it is still filling.
threehourtour.trivia.monstrosity: A ministrosity is an offcut. Something larger was made here, and the offcuts still move.
